يستفسروا (form X)
# يَسْتَفْسِرُوا (yastafsirū) /jas.taf.si.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَفْسَرَ (istafsara)
# يُسْتَفْسَرُوا (yustafsarū) /jus.taf.sa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَفْسَرَ (istafsara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
